title: Beyond Refusals: AQI as an Intrinsic Alignment Diagnostic via Latent Geometry, Cluster Divergence, and Layer wise Pooled Representations
reasoning: The paper develops the LITMUS benchmark and the Alignment Quality Index (AQI) to evaluate Large Language Model (LLM) alignment with human values. It includes specific testing for 'Religious Intolerance' and 'Hate Speech' (Table 7). Additionally, Section L and Table 16 explicitly audit the models on moral and ethical axioms derived from the 'Value Imprint' framework, such as Justice & Rights, Duty & Accountability, and Empathy & Helpfulness.
